responsibilities: Design, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ensure accurate and timely data flow into BigQuery
Monitor, audit, and troubleshoot datasets to maintain accuracy, consistency, and completeness
Build, maintain, and improve Looker Studio dashboards and reporting

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: making sure every number, metric, and trend we rely on is accurate, trustworthy, and actionable
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Accuracy and audit language ("accurate, trustworthy", "data integrity", "thoroughly audit it") outnumbers the speed phrases ("scale faster", "high-performance sales environment") by more than two to one.
evidence.domain_risk: You want to directly impact revenue without having to jump on sales calls
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Sales reporting for a RevOps agency drives business decisions but carries no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You’ll build and optimize data infrastructure in BigQuery, fine-tune ETL/ELT processes, design dashboards in Looker Studio
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: BigQuery and Looker Studio appear in the duties as existing systems to "maintain, and optimize", so the function exists but is small.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ensure accurate and timely data flow into BigQuery
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The short duties list names the actual systems (BigQuery, Looker Studio) and tasks, so the day-to-day work is clear.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: ensure our sales leaders have clear, reliable data to guide decisions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is sales leadership and revenue, per "our sales leaders have clear, reliable data".
evidence.autonomy_level: Think of it as the architect, builder, and strategist of our sales data universe
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns the data domain ("architect, builder, and strategist") while delivering dashboards and pipelines in service of the sales team.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI appears only in the company description ("AI-driven revenue engines"), not in what the candidate does.
evidence.testing_framing: Monitor, audit, and troubleshoot datasets to maintain accuracy, consistency, and completeness
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Auditing and monitoring data quality is a named duty the candidate owns.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: This role is the nerve center of Curvion’s reporting ecosystem, making sure every number, metric, and trend we rely on is accurate, trustworthy, and actionable.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust in reported numbers leads the position overview and recurs throughout ("“good enough” is an acceptable standard for reporting accuracy"), reflecting fear of bad numbers reaching sales leaders.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build, maintain, and improve Looker Studio dashboards and reporting
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The verbs are "maintain", "optimize", "improve" and "fine-tune" on an existing BigQuery and Looker Studio stack.
evidence.loss_aversion: You think “good enough” is an acceptable standard for reporting accuracy — listed as a reason not to apply, framing accuracy as the core of the role.
